        - left
        - top

      color: $ink
      lineHeight: 1.35
      align:
        - left
        - top

      fontFamily: *ref_0

      color: $muted
      lineHeight: 1.2
      align:
        - left
        - top
  tableStyles:
    operating-matrix:
      cellStyle:
        fontFamily: *ref_0
        fontSize: 9.2
        color: $ink
        fill:
          type: solid
          color: $paper
        border:
          color: $rule
          width: 0.7
      firstRowStyle:
        bold: true
        color: $white
        fill:
          type: solid
          color: $navy
